macros.name: Urlmuskip
macros.doc: You can allow some spacing around the breakable characters by assigning \Urlmuskip = 0mu plus 1mu (with mu units because of math mode).

macros.name: urlstyle
macros.doc: You can switch the style of printing using “\urlstyle{xx}”, where “xx” can be any defined style. The pre-defined styles are “tt”, “rm”, “sf” and “same” which all allow the same linebreaks but use different fonts — the first three select a specific font and the “same” style uses the current text font.
